grain_rationale: One source row is one scheduled flight leg departing a New York airport, so the grain is transactional. The profile reports row_count 166158 and duplicate_row_rate 0.0, so no exact duplicate rows exist and no roll-up is required to make rows distinct. No single column is unique on its own: the largest distinct_count among candidate keys is tail_number at 3825 and flight_number at 2994, both far below row_count, so a column identifier is not available. The identity is therefore derived over the ordered tuple flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport, sched_dep_hhmm, which combines the operating day (181 distinct dates spanning 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30), the operating carrier (16 distinct codes), the flight number, the origin airport (EWR, JFK, LGA) and the scheduled departure clock time (969 distinct values); tail_number is excluded because its null_rate is 0.009154 and an identity component must never be null. Because duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, the identity tuple has no exact duplicate rows to absorb.

fields.name: flight_date
fields.description: Local operating date of the flight, with null_rate 0.0 and 181 distinct values from 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30, used as a calendar label and identity component rather than the event timestamp.

fields.name: carrier_code
fields.description: Two-letter operating carrier code with null_rate 0.0 and exactly 16 distinct values such as AA, DL, UA and WN, a classifying label for the flight.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: Carrier-assigned flight number ranging 1 to 8500 across 2994 distinct values with null_rate 0.0; it is an identifier stored as a number and is never summed, so it is a dimension.

fields.name: origin_airport
fields.description: Origin airport code with null_rate 0.0 and only three distinct values EWR, JFK and LGA, confirming the dataset covers New York area departures.

fields.name: sched_dep_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled departure clock time encoded as HHMM, ranging 500 to 2359 over 969 distinct values with null_rate 0.0; it labels a time of day rather than measuring a quantity, so it is a dimension.

fields.name: dest_airport
fields.description: Destination airport code with null_rate 0.0 and 100 distinct values such as ABQ, ATL and BNA, the arrival-side classifying label.

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: Registration mark of the aircraft operating the leg, with 3825 distinct values such as N10156 and N102UW; nullable at null_rate 0.009154 because some rows, including cancelled legs, carry no assigned airframe.

fields.name: is_cancelled
fields.description: Flag with null_rate 0.0 and the two distinct values true and false marking whether the scheduled leg was cancelled, a filtering label for consumers.

fields.name: dep_hhmm
fields.description: Actual departure clock time encoded as HHMM over 1291 distinct values from 1 to 2400; nullable at null_rate 0.029388, consistent with legs that never departed, and it labels a time of day rather than measuring one.

fields.name: dep_delay_minutes
fields.description: Departure delay in minutes ranging -33 (early) to 1301, an additive and comparable quantity across flights; nullable at null_rate 0.029388 because legs without an actual departure have no delay.

fields.name: arr_hhmm
fields.description: Actual arrival clock time encoded as HHMM over 1392 distinct values from 1 to 2400; nullable at null_rate 0.0307 for legs that did not arrive, and it is a time-of-day label rather than a measure.

fields.name: sched_arr_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled arrival clock time encoded as HHMM with null_rate 0.0 and 1134 distinct values from 1 to 2359, a time-of-day label on the scheduled plan.

fields.name: arr_delay_minutes
fields.description: Arrival delay in minutes ranging -86 to 1272, summed and averaged across flights for on-time performance; nullable at null_rate 0.032981 where the leg produced no arrival.

fields.name: air_time_minutes
fields.description: Minutes airborne ranging 20 to 695, an additive quantity for utilisation analysis; nullable at null_rate 0.032981 for legs that never flew.

fields.name: distance_miles
fields.description: Great-circle distance of the origin-destination pair in miles, with null_rate 0.0 and values from 80 to 4983, summed across flights to measure network volume.

fields.name: sched_dep_hour_local
fields.description: Local scheduled departure hour with null_rate 0.0 and exactly 19 distinct values from 5 to 23, a bucketing label for time-of-day analysis.

fields.name: sched_dep_minute_local
fields.description: Local scheduled departure minute with null_rate 0.0 and 60 distinct values from 0 to 59, a clock-component label rather than a measurable quantity.

fields.name: departure_hour_utc
fields.description: UTC scheduled departure timestamp with null_rate 0.0 spanning 2013-01-01T10:00:00 to 2013-07-01T03:00:00, whose samples all land on exact hour boundaries, making it the event timestamp at hour grain.

fields.name: carrier_name
fields.description: Full operating carrier name with null_rate 0.0 and 16 distinct values such as Delta Air Lines Inc. and JetBlue Airways, the readable counterpart of carrier_code.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacturer
fields.description: Airframe manufacturer such as BOEING or AIRBUS across 34 distinct values; nullable at null_rate 0.160426 because the aircraft registry lookup did not resolve every tail_number.

fields.name: aircraft_model
fields.description: Airframe model designation across 121 distinct values such as 172N and 550; nullable at null_rate 0.160426 for the same unresolved registry lookups as aircraft_manufacturer.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacture_year
fields.description: Year the airframe was built, ranging 1956 to 2013 over 46 distinct values; it labels an aircraft vintage rather than measuring a quantity, and it is nullable at null_rate 0.176531 where registry data is missing.

fields.name: aircraft_seat_count
fields.description: Certificated seat capacity of the airframe ranging 2 to 450, compared and averaged across flights as a capacity quantity; nullable at null_rate 0.160426 where the registry lookup failed.

fields.name: aircraft_engine_type
fields.description: Engine family with six distinct values such as Turbo-fan, Turbo-jet and Turbo-prop; nullable at null_rate 0.160426 where the aircraft registry record is absent.

fields.name: origin_airport_name
fields.description: Readable origin airport name with null_rate 0.0 and three distinct values matching the EWR, JFK and LGA codes.

fields.name: origin_municipality
fields.description: City of the origin airport with null_rate 0.0 and the two distinct values New York and Newark.

fields.name: origin_elevation_ft
fields.description: Field elevation of the origin airport in feet with null_rate 0.0 and only three distinct values 13, 18 and 21, an attribute that labels the origin airport rather than a quantity summed across flights.

fields.name: origin_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest runway length at the origin airport in feet with null_rate 0.0 and only three distinct values 7002, 11000 and 14511, an airport attribute label rather than an additive measure.

fields.name: dest_airport_name
fields.description: Readable destination airport name across 99 distinct values such as Bangor International Airport; nullable at null_rate 0.02089 where the destination code has no airport reference record.

fields.name: dest_municipality
fields.description: City of the destination airport across 95 distinct values such as Atlanta and Albuquerque; nullable at null_rate 0.02089 for the same unmatched destination codes.

fields.name: dest_iso_region
fields.description: ISO region of the destination such as US-CA or PR-U-A across 45 distinct values; nullable at null_rate 0.02089 where destination reference data is missing.

fields.name: dest_elevation_ft
fields.description: Field elevation of the destination airport in feet, ranging 3 to 6606 over 90 distinct values; it describes the airport rather than the flight, so it is a dimension, and it is nullable at null_rate 0.02089.

fields.name: dest_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest runway length at the destination airport in feet, ranging 5076 to 16000 over 84 distinct values; an airport attribute label, nullable at null_rate 0.02089 where reference data is missing.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Ingestion capture timestamp with null_rate 0.0 and 16 distinct values clustered between 2026-09-02T23:25:51 and 2026-09-02T23:26:06, retained as a load-batch label and not as the event timestamp.

category_description: One row is one scheduled flight leg departing a New York area airport (EWR, JFK or LGA) on a given operating date, identified by operating carrier, flight number, origin and scheduled departure time, and carrying its actual departure and arrival outcomes, delay and air-time measures, route distance, aircraft attributes and origin and destination airport reference attributes. Cancelled legs are present as rows with is_cancelled true and null actual times.
purpose: This mapping declares how silver.silver_flights enters the gold unified event star as the flights fact category: which column timestamps the event (departure_hour_utc at hour grain), which columns are dimensions versus measures, and how a flight leg is uniquely identified when no single column is unique. Its consumer is the deterministic modeling engine, which reads the approved contract and emits the gold models; downstream analysts consume the category the engine builds, not this document.
usage: The proposal is rendered by deterministic code into an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, checked by the mapping validator and datacontract lint, and then reviewed and edited by a human before approval. Once approved, the modeling engine uses the declared time column, grain, degenerate identity and field roles to generate the gold flights fact; nothing in this proposal executes on its own.
limitations: The mapping only names and classifies existing silver columns: it declares no transformation, no filter and no derived column beyond the flight_identity tuple, so it does not decode the HHMM clock fields into timestamps, does not convert local to UTC times beyond the already-materialised departure_hour_utc, and does not reconcile flight_date with departure_hour_utc across the UTC day boundary visible in the max value 2013-07-01T03:00:00. It does not exclude cancelled legs: is_cancelled carries true for part of the 166158 rows and those rows have null dep_hhmm, arr_hhmm, dep_delay_minutes, arr_delay_minutes and air_time_minutes at null_rate between 0.029388 and 0.032981, so consumers must filter or coalesce as their analysis requires. Aircraft attributes are unresolved for roughly one row in six (null_rate 0.160426, and 0.176531 for aircraft_manufacture_year) and destination reference attributes for about one row in fifty (null_rate 0.02089), so segmentations on those dimensions are incomplete. The mapping carries no quality rules, severities, classifications, service levels, ownership or access policy, which remain the reviewer's domain.
